title: Avelvety Smoked Pork Bisque
description: This fermented, velvety Norwegian dish is a pescatarian-friendly solo-dinner option featuring smoked paprika and slow braising.
instructions: Season pork shoulder with smoked paprika, salt, and a pinch of black pepper.
Place in a roasting pan, pour water over it, add bay leaf and garlic cloves inside the pork cavity for flavoring. Bake for 2 hours or until internal temperature reaches 145°F (63°C).
While cooking, prepare bisque by crushing fermented vegetables to a pulp with a fork.
After resting, shred cooked pork into large chunks.
In a blender, combine shredded pork, fermented vegetable pulp, lemon zest and juice. Blend until smooth.
Pour blended mixture back into the roasting pan, stir gently, then bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat.
Reduce for 20 minutes or until thickened, season with salt as needed.
